label: Houthi Interdiction Corridor
description: Highest global concentration of AIS dark events in 2024. Houthi anti-ship operations have forced extensive AIS manipulation by commercial operators seeking to reduce targeting risk.

label: IRGC Shadow Fleet Area
description: Persistent cluster of AIS dark events associated with Iranian sanctions-evading crude transport. Vessels regularly disable AIS during IRGC-supervised ship-to-ship transfers at Qeshm Island anchorages.

label: Spratly Islands Dark Zone
description: Chinese maritime militia vessels and PLA resupply missions routinely disable AIS in the Spratly Islands. Gap events in this zone are frequently misidentified as fishing vessels.

label: Taiwan Strait Exercise Zone
description: Commercial vessels frequently disable AIS during PLA military exercise periods to reduce identification risk. Gap events cluster around exercise announcement dates.

label: Eastern Mediterranean Sanctions Route
description: AIS dark events in this zone are associated with Iranian-linked vessels delivering fuel and equipment to Hezbollah networks via Lebanese and Syrian coastal approaches. Multiple vessels linked to OFAC-designated entities.

label: South China Sea Central
description: Broad-area AIS dark zone in the central South China Sea. Mix of PLA intelligence-gathering vessels, commercial vessels avoiding Chinese surveillance, and flag-of-convenience tankers on non-declared routes.
